(가)Ants do not speak like humans. But they actually have a "language."

Are do not speak like humans, they actually have a "language".

questions.explanation: 원래 문장은 "Ants do not speak like humans(인간처럼 말하지 않지만). But they actually have a 'language'(그러나 실제로 언어를 가지고 있다)"로 대조 관계입니다. "Though"는 대조를 나타내는 접속사이므로 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[문장]
We often see ants come out of nowhere. Like humans, they live almost everywhere in the world, except a few extremely cold places including Antarctica. As of 2018, there were over 7 billion people on Earth. Then, how about ants? According to scientists, there are about one million ants for every human in the world. Though each ant hardly weighs anything, one million ants are as heavy as a human being Ⓐ ________ about 62 kilograms. What Is the Ant Society Like? Ants live in colonies which have lots of residents living together. Within a colony, there are usually three different types of ants. There is the queen, and Ⓑ________ she does her entire life is lay eggs. The second type of ant is the male that helps the queen produce these eggs. The third type of ant is the worker. Worker ants are all female and do very important jobs, like caring for eggs, defending the colony, and collecting food. How Do Ants Communicate? Ants do not speak like humans. But they actually have a "language." Ants produce a chemical Ⓒ________ a pheromone to communicate with one another. By using the chemical, they can exchange information about food or danger. Ants also use touch for communication. For example, if an ant finds food, it passes on the good news by rubbing its body on its neighbor. Since an ant has legs Ⓓ________ with very sensitive hairs, it can sense even the smallest touch.

윗글의 빈칸 Ⓐ~Ⓓ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation:
Ⓐ: "as heavy as a human being weighing about 62 kilograms" (약 62kg에 해당하는 인간만큼 무겁다) - weighing
ⓑ: "all that she does her entire life" - what
ⓒ: "a chemical called a pheromone" - called
ⓓ: "legs covered with very sensitive hairs" - covered

questions.question:

We often see ants come out of nowhere. Like humans, they live almost everywhere in the world, except a few extremely cold places including Antarctica. Though each ant hardly ___ⓐ____ anything, one million ants are as heavy as a human being ___ⓑ____ about 62 kilograms.

밑줄 친 ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절하게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation:
ⓐ: "each ant"는 단수이지만, 조동사 "does"가 없으므로 동사원형 "weigh"를 사용합니다.
ⓑ: 분사구문으로 "weighing about 62 kilograms"가 정답입니다. 하지만 보기를 보면 "weighs"가 있으므로, 동사는 "weighing"이 아닌 "weighs"로 봅시다. 실제로는 "as a human being weighing about 62 kilograms"가 맞습니다.

어법상 올바른 문장을 <보기>에서 고른 것은?

questions.explanation:
(A) ✓ 현재분사 "sleeping"을 사용한 분사구문이 올바릅니다.
(B) ✗ "wrapping in blue paper" 대신 "wrapped in blue paper"여야 합니다 (과거분사).
(C) ✗ "played" 대신 "playing"이어야 합니다.
(D) ✓ 과거분사 "surrounded"를 사용한 분사구문이 올바릅니다.
정답: (A), (D)

questions.explanation: 3개의 펜이 있습니다. 첫 번째는 red이고, 두 번째와 세 번째를 채워야 합니다. "another"(또 다른 하나)와 "the other"(남은 하나)를 사용합니다. 두 개만 남았을 때는 "the other"를 사용합니다.

By using the chemical, they can exchange information about food or danger. ① Ants also use touch for communication. ② Since an ant has legs covered with very sensitive hairs, it can sense even the smallest touch. ③
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장은 "Ants also use touch for communication"(개미들은 또한 접촉으로 의사소통한다)라는 문장 다음에 와야 합니다. 터치를 통한 의사소통의 구체적인 예시를 제공하므로 ②번이 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 표현 중 어법상 옳지 않은 부분 문장 전체를 쓰시오.

W: Everyone, look at this chestnut tree. This is the oldest tree in these woods.

questions.explanation: "enough big"은 문법적으로 옳지 않습니다. 올바른 표현은 "big enough"입니다. 형용사 앞에 enough를 붙이는 것이 아니라 형용사 뒤에 enough를 붙여야 합니다.

options: On the other hand / In short
questions.question:
[지문]
Ants seem to be busy all the time and never rest. But this is not true. Worker ants rest by taking very short naps about 250 times a day. Each of these naps lasts only about a minute. This means that the worker ants sleep for about four hours each day. __ⓐ__, queen ants fall asleep 90 times a day, and they sleep for about six minutes at a time. This means that they sleep for about nine hours each day. __ⓑ__, ants sleep and rest just like us, though they do so in a different way.

밑줄 친 ⓐ와 ⓑ에 들어갈 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ: 일개미와 여왕개미의 수면 패턴을 비교하므로 "On the other hand"(반면에)가 적절합니다. ⓑ: 앞의 내용을 요약하면서 결론을 내리므로 "In short"(요약하면)이 적절합니다.

Ants seem to be busy all the time and never rest. But this is not true. Worker ants rest ⓐ _____ taking very short naps about 250 times a day. Each ⓑ_____ these naps lasts only about a minute. This means that the worker ants sleep for about four hours each day. On the other hand, queen ants fall asleep 90 times a day, and they sleep for about six minutes ⓒ_____ a time. This means that they sleep for about nine hours each day. In short, ants sleep and rest just ⓓ_____ us, though they do so ⓔ_____ a different way.

다음 ⓐ~ⓔ에 들어갈 수 없는 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ by: "rest by taking" (✓)
ⓑ of: "each of these naps" (✓)
ⓒ at: "at a time" (✓)
ⓓ like: "just like us" (✓)
ⓔ in: "in a different way" (✓)
"by"는 ⓐ에 들어갈 수 있지만, 선택지에서 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 들어갈 수 없는 것을 고르는 문제이므로, 각 위치에 맞지 않는 것을 찾아야 합니다. "by"가 ⓐ 위치에 올 수 없습니다.

ⓓ Can you give me a hand? - Good luck.

questions.explanation:

ⓑ Break a leg = Good luck (✗) He often tells people things that are secrets는 "He has a big mouth"의 의미
ⓒ He has a big mouth = He often tells people things that are secrets (✓) Can you help me?는 틀림
ⓓ Can you give me a hand? = Can you help me? (✓) Good luck는 틀림
ⓔ He shouted at the top of his lungs = He shouted very loudly (✓)

따라서 올바르게 연결된 것은 ⓐ와 ⓔ입니다.

We often see ants come out of nowhere. Like humans, they live almost everywhere in the world, except a few extremely cold places including Antarctica. As of 2018, there were over 7 billion people on Earth. Then, how about ants? According to scientists, there are about one million ants for every human in the world. Though each ant hardly weighs anything, one million ants are as heavy as a human being weighing about 62 kilograms.

Though ants do not speak like humans, they actually have a "language." Ants produce a chemical called a pheromone to communicate with one another. By using the chemical, they can exchange information about food or danger. Ants also use touch for communication. For example, if an ant finds food, it passes on the good news by rubbing its body on its neighbor. Since an ant has legs covered with very sensitive hairs, it can sense even the smallest touch.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것을 고르시오.

③ "one million ants are as heavy as a human being weighing about 62 kilograms"이므로 10억이 아니라 100만 개미입니다.
